title: DOW-UAP-D20, Mission Report, Southern United States, 2020

pages.notes: Document scan is clear with good contrast, but OCR heavily corrupts redacted/strikethrough text and classification headers; narrative mission text is mostly legible but metadata headers show significant garbling.

Military MISREP form with structured fields and FOIA redaction boxes; OCR captures field names and most values correctly but struggles with struck-through/redacted areas, producing garbled text in POC/QC contact information sections.

Declassified military form with equipment specifications; OCR cleanly captures the structured form data and field values (ranks, serial numbers, equipment designators), but garbles the redacted SECRET/NOFORN markings at top and bottom, and misreads some field labels near redactions.

Clean military equipment specification form with redacted fields; OCR corrupts the SECRET/NOFORN header ('Bettm'l'if!fMM!f') but captures ~85% of the main bullet-point content accurately, including weapons systems, radar, and avionics specifications.
Structured military mission timeline form with accurate capture of all operational data, but OCR garbled the security header/footer markings (struck-through SECRET/NOFORN) at top and bottom of page.

Well-scanned document with crisp text, but OCR has errors: spurious 'SEatE iifWl'11 ORL' text at start (not in image), 'Numbed' instead of 'Number', and redaction/exemption box formatting corrupted; core narrative and data fields mostly correct.
